_comment: ECIS + INC-2 RE-HOST FRAME — first-ever exercise of
network.phase_datum_eq34_seed_round_rehost_frame.
Single-knob against _simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480_noewl (= ECIS), which
measured consumer float 585.0 m 3D against ECI's 0.037 m.  The 2026-08-13
bisection localized that break to phase_datum_eq34_seed_round alone
(resolved ECI-vs-ECIS diff = that one behavioural key).
WHY THIS ARM: rehost_frame is the only sub-knob seed_round has, it defaults
false (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:4427-4428), and a repo-wide scan finds it
armed in ZERO configs — so the INC-2 re-host frame recorded as 'built' has
never run.  If the 585 m break is the seed-round realization being re-hosted
onto a stale frame, this is the knob that addresses it.
PRE-REGISTERED:
H1 rehost fixes it  -> consumer returns toward ECI's 0.037 m class and the
settled per-band med|e| stays at or below ECIS's 3779 cyc.
H2 rehost is inert  -> consumer stays ~585 m; the break is elsewhere in
seed_round and the next step is code-side, not config.
H3 rehost trades    -> consumer improves, DD degrades (or vice versa).
Both channels must be read: AR is invoked 0/0 on every arm in this
matrix, so consumer position grades the PRODUCT and never depends on
the integers.  They are independent channels, not a contradiction.
Grade against ECIS only.  Trace population must match (ECIS: 480/480
epochs, 171816 rows, 139 station pairs) — if it does not, the med|e|
comparison is across different populations and only the consumer transfers.
Loader: rehost_frame requires seed_round (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:4431-
4436 forces it OFF otherwise), which this chain arms.
